description: Test suite for the ExecutionState and ExecutionBatch classes within the agentfield.execution_state module, focusing on lifecycle, status transitions, polling, metrics, and batch management.

classes.name: ExecutionState
classes.description: Represents the state and lifecycle of an execution task, including status updates, polling, metrics, and termination conditions.

classes.name: ExecutionBatch
classes.description: Manages a collection of ExecutionState instances, providing batch operations and aggregations.

methods.name: test_execution_state_lifecycle_and_properties()
methods.description: Tests Creation, status transitions, and basic properties of ExecutionState.

methods.name: test_execution_state_failure_and_cancel()
methods.description: Tests error and cancellation handling in ExecutionState.

methods.name: test_polling_and_timeout()
methods.description: Verifies polling logic, timeout detection, and execution timeout handling.

methods.name: test_execution_metrics_computations()
methods.description: Checks metrics calculations such as durations and polling statistics.

methods.name: test_execution_state_post_init_initializes_defaults()
methods.description: Ensures default values are set upon initializing ExecutionState.

methods.name: test_execution_state_str_and_repr()
methods.description: Validates string and repr representations of ExecutionState.

methods.name: test_execution_batch_helpers()
methods.description: Tests batch management functions, including execution addition, removal, and status aggregation.
